en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong will build an “AI City Brain” to improve urban management and bolster emergency response, the city’s leader John Lee has announced in his annual Policy Address.



Security cameras. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. 



Speaking at the Legislative Council on Wednesday, Lee said he would establish an “AI City Brain” task force led by the Chief Secretary.
